name: one debt register schema for books axioms and hypotheses
asks: The debt-ledger pattern already exists three times, unwelded: the CFO's denomination-settled:false on cost records, the Lean library's tracked propext/Quot.sound axiom debt, and the Collatz directory's unpriced second hypothesis (NoPositiveInfiniteBarrierStream, threaded as a bare Prop and provably equivalent in strength to the conjecture itself, while the docs count 'one sorry'). One debt-register schema serves all three. The Collatz case shows why it is needed: 'one sorry' is a self-report, and an unpriced hypothesis is an un-booked erasure — the firm's own accounting law (zhang shi xiang fu, accounts must match reality) applies to its own mathematics. A conditional-surface auditor that counts hypotheses-equivalent-to-conclusion as first-class debt alongside sorry markers would make the Lean corpus keep the same books the firm demands of every unit.
